runtimePolicy.unknownValues: A name match does not verify native distribution, ecology, resource outputs, domestication eligibility or historical introduction.
runtimePolicy.identityPolicy: New taxon IDs use PLT, ANM, ALG or FNG prefixes; forms use FRM. Existing candidate/resource/technology IDs remain unchanged. Never reallocate IDs by sorting.
runtimePolicy.sourceInterpretation: Broad source groups have explicit non-exhaustive representative choices. These are design selections, not unique identifications of the original source or approved spawn lists.
runtimePolicy.resourceInheritance: Candidate resource bindings do not automatically transfer to every selected taxon or form.
runtimePolicy.lineagePolicy: Relations summarize evidence, not automatic gameplay transitions. Hybrid and introgression edges are not domestication edges. An extant species may only proxy an ancestral population.
runtimePolicy.varietyPolicy: Cultivar groups are not species, botanical varieties or named cultivars. No modern named cultivars or animal breeds are invented.
runtimePolicy.floraClassification: The plants folder includes source flora, including algae and lichenized fungi. Their scientific kingdom and ALG/FNG prefixes remain explicit.
runtimePolicy.gameplayIdentity: Gameplay identity is defined by the general plant/animal guide. Scientific names are optional background and never mandatory unlock requirements.

The current research demo still uses wheat/maize aliases. Choose concrete taxa/forms before implementing species-specific progress migration.
